# Wikipedia — overview and bibliography

- Original source: [Wikipedia — overview and bibliography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robin_Hood:_The_Legend_of_Sherwood)
- Author / publication: Wikipedia contributors
- Language / date: English; dynamic article checked 2026-09-09
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Summarizes the 2002 Spellbound tactics game, its Robin Hood story, five-person mission parties, recruitment, and the money needed to ransom Richard. It also provides links to reviews, platforms, and the developer.

The article describes preserving enemy lives as beneficial to recruitment and lists familiar companions such as Marian, Little John, Will Scarlet, Stuteley, and Friar Tuck.

**Limitations:** this is a secondary overview. Its displayed Mac and Linux release dates differ from PCGamingWiki and RuneSoft, so the dates need edition-specific investigation. Use the bibliography to locate original reporting rather than treating every infobox field as settled.

The article is summarized here in original wording; this entry is not a copy of Wikipedia's text.
